rule: Only REUSE_AS_IS rows bind to an existing Category A route. NO_EXISTING_WORK records no form-level crosswalk attempt and does not assert that no match exists.

noExistingWork.basis: the instrument names no form number, so no form-level crosswalk could be attempted; this is 'no match attempted', not 'no match exists'
